mike: Starting coordinated deploy for API=1.9.0, runtime=3.2.1, console=2.0.0, router=2.14.0. Change window 04:00-06:00 UTC. Plan includes pinning router to 2.14.0 for this rollout. Any blockers?
julia: Quick dependency recap — runtime 3.2.1 includes kernel batching and a small kv-cache behavior change. Console requires schema v2.0. Router 2.14 adds header remapping. Canary is needed for each service: 5% for 30m then evaluate.
kevin: LGTM from my side. QA ran the API contract tests; no DB migrations. Rollback plan: router -> 2.13.4, runtime has revert flag --legacy-attn. I'll paste rollback cmds below.
sarah: I can own canary monitoring. Alert thresholds: p95 latency +40% or errors >0.5% -> immediate rollback. I'll post dashboards and pager targets here when deploy starts.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started — run_id=rl-2026-03-20-001. Phase: canary(5%) targeting eu-west & us-east. Sequence: api -> runtime -> router -> console (will honor ordering updates). ETA first phase ~15m.
